note: Synthetic GPT-6 generative-UI message parts for issue #47. The component shapes are transcribed from the issue screenshots; every string here is invented for this fixture, so no real conversation, account, selector report or token is committed. A payload part of this kind is component source rather than markdown, which is why the payload-first read wrote it into the reader's file verbatim.
selection:
<box gap={3}>
  {@body const [choice,setChoice] = DIL.useState("sm")}
  <radio-group direction="col" value={choice} onChange={setChoice}>
    <radio value="sm">Small — one espresso shot</radio>
    <radio value="md">Medium — two shots and steamed milk</radio>
    <radio value="lg">Large — two shots, milk and a second cup</radio>
  </radio-group>
  <button block onClick={()=>GenUI.issueNewTurn(choice="sm"?"Order the small one and confirm the pickup time.":choice="md"?"Order the medium one and confirm the pickup time.":"Order the large one and confirm the pickup time.")}>继续操作 <icon name="arrow-right" inline/></button>
</box>
